# JZZO

> JZZO (Just Zig Zagging Obstacles) is a Los Angeles mashup artist and DJ. The sound is built from underground hip-hop, soul, and crate-dig finds — all mashups, made in LA, posting since October 2022. jzzo.sdfkjh.com is the official home page: watch the latest videos, dig a random track, and find the YouTube channel.

## Links

- [Home](https://jzzo.sdfkjh.com/): official page — latest videos, the "dig the crate" player, and links.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@jzzo-dyt): the channel where mashups are posted.

## Facts

- Artist name: JZZO (alternate: Just Zig Zagging Obstacles).
- Based in: Los Angeles, California.
- Active since: October 2022.
- Genre: hip-hop / soul mashups.
- Contact: hello@jzzo.sdfkjh.com
